lines.text: AMC eight challenge! Think it's twenty-two? Nope!
lines.caption: AMC 8 challenge! Think it's 22? Nope!

lines.text: A point in a rectangle is joined to all four corners.
lines.caption: A point in a rectangle is joined to all 4 corners.

lines.text: Bottom, right and top triangles are fifteen, twenty-two and twenty-five. Find the left one!
lines.caption: Bottom, right and top triangles are 15, 22 and 25. Find the left one!

lines.text: Bottom and top share the width. Their heights stack to the full height.
lines.caption: Bottom and top share the width. Their heights stack to the full height.

lines.text: So together, they are HALF the rectangle.
lines.caption: So together, they are HALF the rectangle.

lines.text: Fifteen plus twenty-five is forty. Slide the point, and it stays forty!
lines.caption: 15 plus 25 is 40. Slide the point, and it stays 40!

lines.text: Left and right make the other half: forty again.
lines.caption: Left and right make the other half: 40 again.

lines.text: Forty, take away twenty-two, is eighteen!
lines.caption: 40, take away 22, is 18!

lines.text: Twenty-two was the trap. Sitting across doesn't make it equal.
lines.caption: 22 was the trap. Sitting across doesn't make it equal.

lines.text: Did you get eighteen? Tell me below!
lines.caption: Did you get 18? Tell me below!
